node.statement: For every Z, dependency 1.5.2.1 gives gamma_ab,n(Z)=h_ab,n^{-1}(mu_ab,n(Z)+d_ab,n(Z)), with ||h_ab,n^{-1}||<=1+C_H e<=5/4, ||mu_ab,n(Z)||=||Z|| by complete isometry, and ||d_ab,n(Z)||<=kappa e||Z||<=||Z||/4. Therefore ||gamma_ab,n(Z)||<=(5/4)(1+1/4)||Z||=(25/16)||Z||<=2||Z||. This non-strict estimate includes Z=0 and is the bound used in the H-CB defect estimate; the remaining displayed arithmetic is unchanged.
